$comment: THE ONE PLACE THE PUBLISHING SCOPE AND REGISTRY ARE SET. Change `scope` here, then run `node scripts/set-scope.mjs` to propagate it to every package.json name, every import in docs and source comments, and the workspace README; `node scripts/set-scope.mjs --check` (wired into `npm run check` as `check:scope`) fails if any package name drifts from it. Change `registry` here, then run `node scripts/set-registry.mjs` to propagate it to every package.json's `publishConfig.registry`; `node scripts/set-registry.mjs --check` (wired into `npm run check` as `check:registry`) fails if any package's declared registry drifts from it. Nothing else in this repository should hardcode a scope or a registry.
status: vespeneventures is a dedicated GitHub organization created to own this repository and its packages, and nothing else. Registry is GitHub Packages, chosen deliberately even though it requires a read:packages token to install (including for public readers with no other relationship to this org) — this is the P0 blocker tracked in issue #194: distribution, not any package API, is what currently keeps a credential-free `npm install` from working for a consumer with no relationship to this org. See docs/DECISIONS.md for the trade-off and docs/PUBLISHING.md's "Migrating to the public npm registry" runbook for the exact ordered steps a repository owner performs to change this value — moving it is a config change here plus separate, irreversible, owner-only setup on the destination registry, not a rewrite of this repository.
